messages.subject: getting wallace to run again
parts:
Hi!
Wallace is awesome - compared to my first steps learning maxent and all R data preparations "by foot", six years ago.
I had a few tries, and now I wonder: once Wallace shuts down/gets stuck in the browser - do I have a chance to get it running again - without starting the whole function again?
Thanks for a hint!
Jana

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: getting wallace to run again
parts:
Jana,

Glad you find Wallace so useful! Working in R by foot must take a long time, and probably makes putting on shoes painful...

Sorry that Wallace was shutting down. If Wallace was crashing, could you please post the error message you get so I can try and fix the problem? Also please make sure you’re using v1.0.4, the latest version. 

If Wallace does crash and goes gray, the only thing you can do, unfortunately, is start it back up. We are working on ways to start the session from a metadata file, and there may be ways in the future to save a state and load it later, but these features aren’t available currently.

Anyway, please post error messages if you get them (they will appear in the R console).

Jamie Kass
PhD Candidate
City College of NY
